scope: Exact counting and architecture bounds, not a solver performance iteration. Historical solvers and measured records remain unchanged.
spaces: All ten frozen n18/n30 prefix and F4-stable spaces
small_validation: All 53 finite GF64 targets, the two frozen d4 spaces and three fresh random independent d4 spaces; exact signed triples, projected oracle sets, trace-fiber counts, and instrumented original hybrid branch counts
larger_target_checks: All 24 saved cold inputs, all 80 saved batch targets, and 60 new uniform targets; compare hypothetical complete hybrid multiplication floors to the measured S3 work on the exact same eight-target batches
claims_to_test: Exact signed admissible triple mass equals 8*C(K,3) minus infinity triples and target-abscissa collisions.
The trace-fiber support ceiling never exceeds the corrected global first-moment ceiling.
Trace fibers may expose concentration or certify empty target classes; a gain is not assumed.
The original hybrid's completed enumeration performs the predicted number of conditioned-root branches, unaffected by its later parity rejection.
Saved complete S3 batches exceed the derived field-multiplication lower bound and have exactly K*(K-1) pair-table entries.
falsification: Any exact small-field disagreement, source/input hash change, negative corrected fiber mass, or violation of a work bound invalidates that claim. Retain negative results. Probability ceilings are not observed success rates or guarantees of successful solving.
limits: Uniform affine full-group targets only. Signed multiplicity is distinguished from projected x-tuples. Actual curve orders are composite; no prime-subgroup or full-DLP rho ratio follows. Trace analysis and independent oracle work are charged as research-harness work, not hidden in a solver speedup.
